text: Students can apply for the program all year round. Compulsory courses: Advanced Chinese: Students taking these courses also use Duiwai Hanyu Xilie Jiaocai. If needed, special textbooks like Speaking Chinese, Talking about Culture and Business Chinese are also used. Optional Couses: 1. Calligraphy: Introduing the original and aesthetic meaning of Chinese characters and appreciating the deep conotation of Chinese calligraphy. 2. History and Culture: Introduing the mysterious culture and long history of China. 3. Maritial Arts: A window for foreign students learning about China, at the same time improves physical strength. 4. Chinese Folk Songs: Learning to sing traditional Chinese folk songs. 5. Guidance Class for Chinese Level Exams (HSK): On the request of students, thus special guidance class is offered for further studies or specific occupations.
